name: Пушок
canon: Puff is a slightly taller soft lavender bean-shaped creature, two small round ears on top of its head, tiny dot eyes, a small straight-line mouth, rosy cheeks, smooth simple silhouette, hand-drawn black uneven outline, pastel colored pencil texture.
movement: Slow, smooth, minimal movements. Puff rarely moves unnecessarily. Long pauses, subtle head tilts and deadpan stares are essential. Sudden ear movements create unexpected comedy.
check: no horns, tails or extra ears
phrases: И что могло пойти не так?
